Hi there! My name is Tom and I am currently a Masters of Environmental Data Science (MEDS) student at the Bren School of Environmental Science & Management. I am passionate about marine ecology and fisheries management, and I am eager to explore data-driven solutions across a variety of environmental fields through the skills I gain in this program. Outside of school, I enjoy all the activities that Southern California has to offer, such as hiking, surfing, fishing, and being in the sun!
